tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Use to find team ids and abbreviations for a season (default: the latest). Every other tool takes a team as an id or abbreviation. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Use to list games with runs, hits and errors by season, date, date range or team, newest first. For upcoming games with lines use get_schedule; for one game's box score use get_game. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming games (next 1-30 days, default 7) with the median line across posted sportsbooks: moneylines, run line and total. For every book's line use get_odds. Costs 2 credits. Prices are market information; no tool places, accepts or tracks wagers.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use for one game in full: line score, every batter's and pitcher's line, each sportsbook's opening and closing line, and the win-probability range. For every plate appearance use get_plate_appearances. Costs 5 credits. Prices are market information; no tool places, accepts or tracks wagers.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Use for a season's regular-season standings computed from every final game: record, home and away, last 10, runs scored and allowed, run differential and Pythagorean win percentage. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Use for the injury report: every listed player's status, injury and expected return, as captured on the latest day (or the latest on or before date). Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id by name (partial names work). Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for a player's season-by-season batting (AVG, OBP, SLG, OPS, HR, K%, BB%, RE24, from every plate appearance) and pitching (ERA, WHIP, K/9, BB/9). Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_games
tools.description: Use for a player's game log: every game's batting line and pitching line, newest first, optionally one season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Use for a season's leaders among qualified players: batting avg, obp, slg, ops, hr, re24, bb_pct, k_pct (3.1 plate appearances per team game) or pitching era, whip, so, k_per_9, bb_per_9 (1 inning per team game). Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use for team offence and run prevention for a season: runs per game for and against, run differential, and batting and opponents' batting (AVG, OBP, SLG, OPS, K%, BB%, HR) from every plate appearance. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_plate_appearances
tools.description: Use for plate-appearance play-by-play: a whole game in order, or a batter's, pitcher's or team's season, with the base-out state before, the result, the batted ball (trajectory and location), runs, the home win probability after (our model, every plate appearance since 2015) and our run value (RE24)

tools.name: get_pitches
tools.description: Use for pitch-by-pitch data: every pitch of a game, or a pitcher's or batter's season, with the count, pitch type, velocity, location and result. Velocity is whole mph as published, cut down rather than rounded (95.8 reads 95), so averages run about half a mile per hour under the published one-decim

tools.name: get_pitch_mix
tools.description: Use for a pitcher's arsenal in a season: each pitch type's usage, average and top velocity, whiff rate per swing and ball rate. Velocities come from whole-mph readings cut down rather than rounded, so the averages run about half a mile per hour under the published one-decimal figures. Costs 5 credit

tools.name: get_spray_chart
tools.description: Use for where a batter or team hits the ball: balls in play by trajectory (ground ball, line drive, fly ball, pop-up) and by field (left, center, right), with hit rates; include_balls adds each ball's location for drawing. Counts the regular season and postseason together unless season_type says oth

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Use for betting lines: each sportsbook's moneyline, run line and total for a game (opening and closing per book from July 2020; before that, each book's final pregame line only), with implied probabilities and, for finished games, whether the favourite won and the total went over against the median

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Use to see how a game's line moved before first pitch: our pre-game snapshots of each sportsbook's moneyline, run line and total (captured once a day, and every hour for games in the next four days). Costs 10 credits. Prices are market information; no tool places, accepts or tracks wagers.

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our team power ratings (Elo from every final game in our data), ranked, as of the end of a season or today. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Use for player prop lines by sportsbook: over/under on hits, home runs, total bases, RBI, pitcher strikeouts and pitcher outs, from May 2023 (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, Pinnacle and others). tools.name: get_prop_movement
tools.description: Use to see how one player's prop line moved before a game: every capture we hold, book by book and oldest first, with the line, both prices and the minutes before the start. line_change is the last capture's line minus the first's. tools.description: Use for the extra betting markets of a game as history: the first 5 innings winner, run line and total, and the 1st inning total and three-way result (the 1st inning total at 0.5 is the no-run-first-inning market). tools.description: Use for alternate run lines and totals by sportsbook: every point on each book's ladder with its price (e.g. -2.5 at +190, over 9.5 at +140), for one game.
